Subject: Question on prorated charge if we add seats mid-cycle

Hi Rachel,

Quick question — we need to add 12 seats to our Dedicated pool effective June 3. Our billing cycle runs 1st–30th. Can you confirm how proration will be calculated for the remainder of the June billing period and whether VAT applies to the partial month charge? Our EU entity (Acme Logistics GmbH) is the party on the June PO, but the account is registered in the US.

I'm attaching the May invoice so you can see the current seat count. Also: we'll pay by wire and need an updated invoice with the VAT handling noted for our AP team.

Thanks,
Elena Moretti

Acme Logistics

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com

Date: 2026-05-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on prorated charge if we add seats mid-cycle

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the invoice. Looping in Dev (billing) and Lauren (AM) to confirm specifics.

Short answers up front:
- Proration: we charge for the unused portion of the month at the per-seat rate prorated by days remaining in the billing period. For your change effective Jun 3, proration will cover Jun 3–Jun 30 (28 days out of 30 for June).
- Calculation example: your per-seat monthly rate is $120. For 12 seats added on Jun 3: prorated amount = 12 * $120 * (28/30) = $1,344.
- VAT: since you indicated the invoice will be issued to Acme Logistics GmbH (EU), VAT handling depends on whether you provide a valid EU VAT ID and whether the supply is treated as B2B cross-border. Please confirm the VAT number and invoicing entity.

I've attached a quick proration_schedule.csv and a draft updated invoice for review. Dev — can you confirm the backend rounding rules we apply (we typically round to the nearest cent and include a one-line proration breakdown on the invoice)?

Next steps:
1) Elena to confirm invoicing entity and VAT ID.
2) We issue an updated invoice showing prorated line item + VAT treatment.
3) Elena to route to AP for wire instructions once invoice is accepted.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
rachel@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
Attachment: proration_schedule.csv, updated_invoice_Jun2026.pdf

Thanks for the context — confirming billing behavior and tax notes.

Details from billing system:
- Rounding: we compute prorated per-seat daily rate as (monthly_rate / days_in_month) then multiply by eligible days, summing across seats and rounding the final invoice line to 2 decimal places.
- Example calculation (June): monthly_rate $120 -> daily $4.00. For 28 days = $112 per seat -> 12 seats = $1,344.00.
- If seats are added in the middle of the day we prorate by full days; June 3 effective means charges start 6/3 inclusive.

VAT handling options:
1) If invoice is issued to Acme Logistics GmbH and you provide a valid EU VAT ID: we issue invoice with reverse-charge (no VAT) and include your VAT ID on the invoice.
2) If Acme pays via its US parent (and EU entity is not the billed party): we will charge US sales tax (if applicable) or zero VAT depending on nexus.

Please provide: invoicing entity name exactly as on your PO, your EU VAT ID (if applicable), and preferred payment terms (wire, net 30, or prepay). Once we have that we'll reissue the invoice.

I'll prepare the final numbers and update the invoice PDF once we have the VAT ID.
